organization.short_description:
PRIMUS Techsystems Private Limited, founded in 2010 and headquartered in Pune, India, is a technology consulting and services company. It specializes in enterprise application solutions, focusing on SAP, Salesforce, and Siemens technologies to support digital transformation for midmarket enterprises. The company employs around 638-792 people and has reported revenue of $17 million.

PRIMUS offers a wide range of services, including end-to-end implementation and support for various SAP products, Salesforce consulting and integration, and Siemens PLM solutions. The company is recognized for its efficiency and innovation, having filed two patents and serving over 60 active customers across industries such as automotive, manufacturing, pharma, and utilities. PRIMUS is also noted for its partnerships as a trusted SAP partner and Salesforce AppExchange consulting partner, providing tailored solutions to enhance performance in ERP, CRM, and PLM ecosystems.

organization.short_description:
Danish Power Limited is an Indian manufacturer and exporter of power equipment, established in 1985 and headquartered in Jaipur. The company specializes in transformers, control relay panels, compact substations, and substation automation services. With over 35 years of experience, Danish Power is recognized for its commitment to quality and innovation, holding multiple ISO certifications and being the first in India to obtain a BIS License for Ester-filled Transformers.

The company offers a range of products, including inverter duty transformers, distribution transformers, power transformers, and control relay panels. Their solutions are designed for applications in power transmission, distribution, and automation, supporting sectors such as renewable energy, power generation, and industrial operations. Danish Power also provides services for substation development and industrial automation, ensuring customized solutions for various projects.
